# PTMods: managing post-translational modifications in R

![](stickers/PTMods.png)

[![license](http://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL%20%28%3E=%203%29-brightgreen.svg?style=flat)](http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.md)

A package to managing post-translational modifications in `R`.

The [reference
manual](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/articles/PTMods.html)
is a good way to get started with the package.

## Suggested packages

We highly suggest combining `PTMods` with
[PSMatch](https://github.com/rformassspectrometry/PSMatch) and
[Spectra](https://github.com/rformassspectrometry/Spectra) for a more
complete approach to analysing mass spectrometry data in R.

## Installation instructions

To install the package from Bioconductor, make sure you have the
`BiocManager` package, available from CRAN, and then run

\
`BiocManager``::`[`install`](https://bioconductor.github.io/BiocManager/reference/install.html)`(``"PTMods"``)`

## Contributions

Contributions are welcome, and should ideally be provided through a
Github pull request. Feel free to discuss any more non-trivial
suggestions or changes first in an issue. See also the main [R for Mass
Spectrometry contribution
guide](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/RforMassSpectrometry/articles/RforMassSpectrometry.html#contributions)
and [code of
conduct](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/RforMassSpectrometry/articles/RforMassSpectrometry.html#code-of-conduct)

The `PTMods` code is provided under a

distributed under a [CC BY-SA
license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/).

## Credit

Code in this package is focused on the use of UniMod data and the
[ProForma](https://github.com/HUPO-PSI/ProForma) standard Proteoform and
Peptidoform Notation formats with the goal to integrate them within the
[*R for Mass Spectrometry*](https://github.com/rformassspectrometry)
infrastructure.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`PTMods`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/PTMods-package.md)
  [`PTMods-package`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/PTMods-package.md)
  : Managing amino acid modifications for mass spectrometry in R.
- [`addFixedModifications()`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/addFixedModifications.md)
  : Add fixed modifications
- [`addModifications()`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/addModifications.md)
  : Add fixed and variable modifications to peptide sequences
- [`addVariableModifications()`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/addVariableModifications.md)
  : Add variable modifications
- [`aminoacids`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/aminoacids.md)
  : Amminoacids data set.
- [`combineModifications()`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/combineModifications.md)
  : Combines consecutive modifications on amino acids in peptide
  sequences.
- [`convertAnnotation()`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/convertAnnotation.md)
  : Convert sequences from one annotation style to another
- [`elements`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/elements.md)
  : Elements data set.
- [`getCanonicalSequence()`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/getCanonicalSequence.md)
  : Get canonical sequence from any peptidoform
- [`getModificationsCounts()`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/getModificationsCounts.md)
  : Extract modification counts from one or more peptide sequences
- [`modifications`](https://rformassspectrometry.github.io/PTMods/reference/modifications.md)
  : Modifications data set.
